cloud_globe_not_published: Not published yet (publish to open it)
cloud_globe_stale: Open the public page (changes not published yet)
cloud_publish_needs_token: Publishing needs a Cloudflare API token.
cloud_publish_setup_link: Set it up under Site → Cloudflare publication settings (the steps are explained there)
cloud_publish_needs_public_worker: Publishing is not possible: no public Worker is set. Set a public Worker separate from the management Worker.
